name: Fandom_Benchmark_Bandori
description: A small fandom-specific QA/knowledge benchmark built from Bandori (BanG Dream!) Fandom wiki content that measures models' ability to answer factual questions about characters, events, and lore. Tasks are primarily short-answer/open-ended and require retrieving or synthesizing information from fandom articles. It targets knowledge and retrieval performance on niche domain content.
reputation: Niche, community-curated dataset with limited but useful adoption for fandom-specific QA testing.
